description: This file defines the 'Condition' class, which models detailed information about health conditions, illnesses, or diagnoses within the OpenMRS healthcare system. It includes annotations for ORM mapping, fields for condition attributes, and methods for managing condition data.

classes.name: Condition
classes.description: Represents a health condition, diagnosis, or problem, including relevant details such as clinical status, verification status, related patient, and occurrence dates.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Compares this Condition with another to determine if they have the same meaningful properties, ignoring identifiers.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new copy of a given Condition object with the same properties but different UUID/ID.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Copies property values from one Condition to another, producing a new instance with the same data but different identifiers.
